fr.recommendations: • No significant responder access or movement concerns are visible from the available imagery.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang over or touch the roof and walls of the structure.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the foundation and exterior walls.
• Thin grouped trees near the structure to create open space between individual trees.
• Clear dead plant material from beneath shrubs and trees close to the house.
• Keep grass and low vegetation cut short in the open areas immediately surrounding the structure.
• Separate shrub groupings near the structure so open ground exists between them.
• Remove any cut or dead vegetation left on the ground near the structure after trimming work.
• Keep all access routes clear of low-hanging branches that could block a vehicle.
• Maintain open, drivable width along all routes leading to the structure.
• Move any stored wood, yard debris, or flammable materials away from the exterior walls of the structure.
